name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.7.21
body:
**Bug fixes**
- Fixed "update/stage latest firmware" regressions caused by moving it from Expert to Dashboard tab.
- Deleting a single file would sometimes require a page refresh to show it being removed.

**Dashboard**
- Cleaned up Dashboard layout when cards expand.
- fwup check button stays pressed while performing check.
- fw tag removed from top bar.
- Glazed theme is now the former middle option. Slider removed.
